syllabus_topics: Multimedia, basic terms, examples, multimedia production
assessment_rules: To successfully complete the course, students must obtain at least 75% of points on the homework assignment and at least 60% of points on the final exam. Final grade: A 90%, B 86%, C 80%, D 70%, E 60%. The scale of assessment (preliminary/final) is 40/60.

Salanci, Ľ.: Práca s grafikou. Bratislava, SPN 2000
